notes.title: An Honest Update Game Dev Isn’t Always Easy 2.0
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]I’m excited to share honest devlog[b] [/b]2.0 with you all. my most honest update yet. 

Here’s what you’ll find:[/p][list][*][p][b]Our Origin Story[/b]: From a humble stick-man sketch to our fully animated red bird.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Animation Spotlight[/b]: A peek inside our massive state tree (hundreds of clips for one character!).[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Feature Reveal[/b]: Try out the floating ability I’m most proud of.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Real Talk[/b]: The ups, the downs, and the big question… did I make the right choice?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Looking Ahead[/b]: What would you like to see in Devlog 3.0? Your feedback really guides this project.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Watch the full update here: 

[/p][previewyoutube="TkvBAljZ3e0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]


And if you’ve been enjoying the journey so far, please add us to your wishlist.

every single wishlist fuels this dream. [/p][p]Thank you for your support, and see you in Devlog 3.0!
— Maik [/p]
